Test: [ShContentAclServiceTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/acl/ShContentAclServiceTest.java) (default-allow, explicit grant denies others, READ≠WRITE, folder-tree inheritance to subfolder+post, admin bypass). **Drive-by test fix:** several `@BeforeAll` setups looked up the seeded `Text` widget with `findByName` — which throws `NonUniqueResultException` if the shared in-memory test DB (`DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1`, reused across Spring contexts) has accumulated duplicate `Text` widgets from other tests that create them (`ShWidgetAPITest`, `ShCdaPostTypeSchemaTest`); adding the ACL context reshuffled class order and surfaced it. Switched those setups to the existing duplicate-tolerant `findFirstByName` (the SH16 convention). Green on full backend suite + console `tsc -b`. → ROADMAP §III.9
- **SH53** — **Content i18n / locales (locale axis + linked translations + CDA `?locale`).** Posts were single-language; the seeded-but-unused `ShLocale` table had no surface. SH53 adds a locale axis to the unified store. **Model decision:** `locale` + `translationGroupId` are plain columns on [ShPostUnified](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/post/unified/ShPostUnified.java) — **not** added to the `(id, state)` composite key, so the PK, the publish/restore two-row logic and the SH26 cross-DB schema stay untouched. Each translation is its **own** post (own id) linked to its siblings by a shared `translationGroupId`; `locale` defaults to `en` (Java field default + Liquibase backfill) and a standalone post's group is its own id. Liquibase [v2026.3.6.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.3.6.yaml): two `addColumn`s, `locale` backfilled `'en'`, `translation_group_id` backfilled `valueComputed: id`. **Write path** ([ShPostUnifiedWriteService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/migration/unified/ShPostUnifiedWriteService.java)): `create` pre-assigns the id (so the group can default to self) and accepts `locale`/`translationGroupId`; **every row-creation path** (`create`/`publish`/`restoreDraftFromPublished`/`draftFromPublished`) now carries both fields, so publishing/restoring a translation preserves its locale + linkage. New `translate(sourceId, locale, data, owner)` creates a linked DRAFT sibling (same folder/type/site, data seeded from the source when omitted) and `listTranslations(postId)` returns the group's siblings (DRAFT-preferred). **API:** `POST /api/v2/post-unified/{id}/translate` + `GET /{id}/translations` ([ShPostUnifiedAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/unified/ShPostUnifiedAPI.java); `CreatePayload` gains `locale`/`translationGroupId`). **CDA:** `GET /api/v2/cda/post/by-url` accepts `?locale=` ([ShCdaAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShCdaAPI.java)/[ShCdaService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShCdaService.java)`.getPostByUrl(siteId,url,locale)` via new `findByShSite_IdAndFurlAndStateAndLocale`), so the same URL resolves the right translation; the frozen DTOs gain `locale` ([ShCdaPostSummary](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/dto/ShCdaPostSummary.java)) and `locale`+`availableLocales` ([ShCdaPost](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/dto/ShCdaPost.java), computed from the translation group) — additive, so a headless front can render a language switcher. **`ShLocale` put to work:** new read-only [ShLocaleAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/locale/ShLocaleAPI.java) `GET /api/v2/locale`. **Console:** a [PostTranslationsMenu](../shio-react/src/components/post-translations.menu.tsx) in the post editor save bar — lists sibling translations (switch to one) and offers the remaining locales to create a new linked translation — over the extended [post-unified.service.ts](../shio-react/src/services/post-unified/post-unified.service.ts) (`translate`/`translations`) + new [locale.service.ts](../shio-react/src/services/locale/locale.service.ts); en/pt i18n. Test: [ShContentLocaleTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShContentLocaleTest.java) (create defaults en + own group; translate links a sibling; CDA resolves per-locale + reports availableLocales). Green on full backend suite + console `tsc -b`. → ROADMAP §III.8
- **SH52** — **Content full-text search (in-DB + CDA endpoint + console).** The CDA `/query` was filter-only (siteId/folderId/postType); there was no way to *search* content. SH52 adds a full-text endpoint **`GET /api/v2/cda/search?q=&siteId=&page=&size=`** ([ShCdaAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShCdaAPI.java)), returning the same frozen `ShCdaListing` of summaries as `/query`. **Engine decision:** in-DB, **not** the ecosystem's Turing — a portable case-insensitive `LIKE` over the post **title + summary + raw attribute `data`** ([ShPostUnifiedRepository](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/repository/post/ShPostUnifiedRepository.java), six new `@Query` methods sharing a `FULLTEXT_PREDICATE` constant), keeping the SH26 cross-DB guarantee that engine-specific `FULLTEXT`/`tsvector` would break. `summary`/`data` are CLOB-mapped and Hibernate 7 rejects `lower()` on a CLOB argument, so those two are `lower(cast(... as string))`; `title` is a plain VARCHAR. **Service** ([ShCdaService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShCdaService.java)`.search`): published-only in PROD, draft-preferred under a PREVIEW token (reusing the SH5 `draftPreferred` in-memory dedup), and it **inherits the SH2 per-site allow-list** — a single `siteId` is allow-list-checked, an unscoped search spans the token's allowed sites (or every site for a no-allow-list/console caller). **Consumes `ShSite.searchablePostTypes`** (the spec's intent — the field existed but was never parsed): for a single-site search, results are restricted to that site's configured post-types, tolerantly parsed (JSON array or comma/newline list) and **validated against real post-types** so a malformed/foreign config degrades to "search all types" rather than silently returning nothing. **Console:** the long-defined-but-unrouted `ROUTES.SEARCH` (`/content/search`) is now a real [search.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/content/search.page.tsx) — query box + site selector ("All sites") + results table (click → post editor) — over a new [ShSearchService](../shio-react/src/services/search/search.service.ts) + [search.model.ts](../shio-react/src/models/search/search.model.ts), wired into `content.routes.tsx` + the Content sidebar group (Search icon), with en/pt `content.search*` i18n. Test: [ShCdaSearchTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShCdaSearchTest.java) (title + body-only match, draft excluded in PROD, unscoped, unknown term + blank query empty). Green on full backend suite + console `tsc -b`. **Unblocks SH59** (search config console page) + SH33 (MCP read tools, which assumed a search primitive). → ROADMAP §III.7
- **SH51** — **Audit / history API + console Activity viewer.** The [ShHistory](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/history/ShHistory.java) entity (+ its two repositories) had been part of the model since the start but was **never written and never read** — SH14 only diffs DRAFT↔PUBLISHED. SH51 closes both ends. **Write side:** new [ShContentAuditService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/history/ShContentAuditService.java)`.record(`[ShContentAction](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/history/ShContentAction.java)`, postId, siteId, title, actor)` persists one `ShHistory` row per unified-post transition; it is called **inline within the caller's write transaction** from [ShPostUnifiedWriteService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/migration/unified/ShPostUnifiedWriteService.java) on `create`/`update`/`publish`/`unpublish`/`delete`/`restore` (CREATE/UPDATE/PUBLISH/UNPUBLISH/DELETE/RESTORE). Inline — not an `AFTER_COMMIT` listener like the SH12 webhook dispatcher — on purpose: the audit row must commit/roll back atomically with the change it describes, and Hibernate's `@TenantId` discriminator needs the request-thread `ShTenantContext` an async listener could lose. To capture *who* on every path, `unpublish`/`delete` gained an `actor` parameter ([ShPostUnifiedAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/unified/ShPostUnifiedAPI.java) passes the `Principal`; the SH15 scheduler passes `"scheduler"`). **Model:** `ShHistory` gains a structured `action` column (Liquibase [v2026.3.5.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.3.5.yaml) — `addColumn action VARCHAR(255)`, `QUOTE_ALL_OBJECTS` + `columnExists` MARK_RAN guard, DB-agnostic) so the trail records *what happened*, not just a free-text description. **Read side:** [ShHistoryAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/history/ShHistoryAPI.java) at `/api/v2/history` (console-authenticated, tenant-scoped by the `@TenantId`) — `GET` recent, `GET /object/{id}`, `GET /site/{id}`, all newest-first via a new `ShHistoryPageableRepository.findAllByOrderByDateDesc`, capped (`limit` ≤ 500), returning a `ShHistoryResponse` DTO that never leaks `tenant_id`. **Console:** a **Activity** admin page ([activity.list.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/admin/activity/activity.list.page.tsx)) — a refreshable table of action-badge / description / who / when over a new [ShHistoryService](../shio-react/src/services/history/history.service.ts) + [history.model.ts](../shio-react/src/models/history/history.model.ts), wired into `admin.routes.tsx` + `ADMIN_ACTIVITY` + the Administration sidebar (History icon), with en/pt `activity` i18n. Test: [ShHistoryAPITest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/history/ShHistoryAPITest.java) (CREATE+PUBLISH recorded, read back newest-first by object/site, recent list). Green on full backend suite + console `tsc -b`. → ROADMAP §III.6
- **SH26** — **Cross-DB schema-drift guard (H2 + MariaDB + PostgreSQL).** The schema is Liquibase-managed (`ddl-auto=none`), kept "agnostic" only by a *textual lint* ([ShLiquibaseChangelogAgnosticTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/db/ShLiquibaseChangelogAgnosticTest.java)) — but the changelogs were **never actually applied** on the MariaDB/PostgreSQL engines whose drivers ship (dev + the whole suite run on H2, and tests even skip Liquibase). Three Testcontainers-backed ITs ([com.viglet.shio.tenant](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant)) now boot the **full Spring context** against each engine with `spring.liquibase.enabled=true` + `ddl-auto=none` — proving the full `db.changelog-master.yaml` applies, every entity maps onto the Liquibase-built schema (the `ShOnStartup` seed inserts run real DML), and `ShTenantBackfillRunner.TENANT_TABLES` resolves: [ShH2SchemaIT](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShH2SchemaIT.java) (no Docker — runs on every `mvn verify`), [ShMariaDbSchemaIT](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShMariaDbSchemaIT.java) + [ShPostgresSchemaIT](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShPostgresSchemaIT.java) (`@Testcontainers(disabledWithoutDocker=true)`). They surfaced **two real cross-DB defects + one silent bug**, all fixed: (1) the generated baseline used inline **`ENUM('DRAFT','PUBLISHED')`** on `sh_post_unified` — accepted by H2/MySQL/MariaDB, **rejected by PostgreSQL** (`type "enum" does not exist`); changed to `VARCHAR(16)` (the entity is `@Enumerated(STRING) @Column(length=16)`) with `validCheckSum: ANY`, and `ENUM(` added to the forbidden-token lint so it can't return. (2) **Identifier casing** — tables are PascalCase entity names (`ShPostType`, no `@Table`) and Hibernate runs `globally_quoted_identifiers=true`, so it references them quoted/case-preserved; Liquibase created them unquoted, which **PostgreSQL folds to lower-case** → `"ShPostType"` never matched. Fixed by declaring **`objectQuotingStrategy: QUOTE_ALL_OBJECTS`** in each changelog file (set at the changelog level, not per-changeSet, so it doesn't alter checksums; repeated per file since it doesn't propagate through `include`) — Liquibase now preserves the exact case on every engine; H2/MariaDB were already tolerant. (3) **`ShTenantBackfillRunner.TENANT_TABLES`** listed **snake_case** names (`sh_post_type_attr`, …) while the real tables are PascalCase (`ShPostTypeAttr`); every name matched nothing and the runner swallowed "table not found" at `debug`, so the pre-multi-tenant backfill silently no-op'd — rewritten to the real names (incl. the previously-missing `site_webhook`). Testcontainers deps (`testcontainers`/`testcontainers-junit-jupiter`/`testcontainers-mariadb`/`testcontainers-postgresql`, versions from the Spring Boot BOM) added test-scoped. 9 IT tests (3 × 3 engines) green; 103 unit tests still green. Spec: `docs/specs/SH26-cross-db-schema-guard.md`.
- **SH16** — **The `shio` CLI + post-types as code.** A `@viglet/shio` command-line tool for the "JS dev, zero Java" workflow, backed by a new lossless post-type admin API so the content model round-trips as version-controlled JSON. **Backend:** lossless DTOs [ShPostTypeDef](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/dto/ShPostTypeDef.java)/[ShPostTypeAttrDef](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/dto/ShPostTypeAttrDef.java) (the authoring inverse of SH11's lossy CDA schema — keep `Tab`, verbatim `widgetSettings`, nested Relator fields, no ids) mapped by [ShPostTypeAdminMapper](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/ShPostTypeAdminMapper.java); [ShPostTypeAdminService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/ShPostTypeAdminService.java) `list`/`get`/`upsert`/`delete` — upsert is idempotent by name, resolves each widget via `ShWidgetRepository.findByName` ([ShUnknownWidgetException](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/ShUnknownWidgetException.java) → 400), and **detaches the `@ManyToOne(cascade=ALL)` `shWidget`/`shPostType`/`shParentPostTypeAttr` associations before the orphan-removal replace, so an update never cascade-deletes the shared widget catalog or the post-type itself**; system types are read-only ([ShSystemPostTypeException](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/ShSystemPostTypeException.java) → 409). **API:** [ShPostTypeAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/ShPostTypeAPI.java) at `/api/v2/post-type` (GET list/one, PUT upsert, DELETE) — console-authenticated (HTTP Basic) and **CSRF-exempt** in [ShSecurityConfig](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/security/ShSecurityConfig.java) (`POST_TYPE_PATH` added to `ignoringRequestMatchers`, same rationale as the SH10 CDA writes — the stateless CLI has no session/XSRF cookie). No schema change (writes existing tables); no new role. **CLI:** new workspace package [`@viglet/shio`](../cli) (pure-Node ESM, deps `@viglet/shio-client` + `create-shio-app`): `init` (→ `create-shio-app/scaffold`, new `exports` entry so the scaffolder is reused, not re-implemented), `types` (wraps the SH11 `generateShioTypes`, CDA token), `pull` (lossless defs → deterministic `shio/post-types/*.json`, Basic auth), `push` (`diffDefs`/`planPush` against the live model; `--dry-run` previews; `--prune` deletes non-system removals), `dev` (types + spawn the site dev server + interval refresh), `deploy` (`push`+`types`). Auth split: model edits (`pull`/`push`/`deploy`) use console `SHIO_USER`/`SHIO_PASSWORD`; delivery (`types`/`dev`) uses `SHIO_CDA_TOKEN`. The diff/serialize/plan core ([post-types-io.mjs](../cli/src/post-types-io.mjs)) is pure (prune never targets system types). **Wiring:** `cli` added to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` + root `test`; `publish-js-sdk.yml` bumps/publishes `@viglet/shio` after the core + starter. Tests: `ShPostTypeAdminServiceTest` (lossless round-trip, cascade-safe update keeps the shared widget, unknown widget, system read-only, delete) + **15 `node:test` green** in `cli/test`. Spec: `docs/specs/SH16-shio-cli.md`.
- **SH15** — **Scheduled publish/unpublish.** A post can carry a `publishAt`/`unpublishAt` instant; a background sweep fires the due transition — reusing the existing publish/unpublish path, so the **SH12 webhook fires identically** to a manual one. **Model:** [ShPostUnified](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/post/unified/ShPostUnified.java) gains two nullable `Date` columns — `publishScheduledDate`/`unpublishScheduledDate` — carried on the editable `DRAFT` row; new Liquibase [v2026.2.3.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.2.3.yaml) (two `addColumn` changesets, `columnExists` MARK_RAN guards, DB-agnostic `TIMESTAMP`) wired into the master. **Service:** [ShPostUnifiedWriteService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/migration/unified/ShPostUnifiedWriteService.java) gains `schedule(postId, publishAt, unpublishAt, modifier)` (sets/clears both fields on the draft, re-creating it from `PUBLISHED` if absent — shared `draftFromPublished` helper with SH14 restore), the due-finders `findScheduledPublishDue`/`findScheduledUnpublishDue` (DRAFT rows whose schedule `<= now`), and `publishScheduled`/`unpublishScheduled` which **clear the fired field first (same tx, can't re-fire)** then delegate to `publish`/`unpublish`. **Sweep:** [ShPostScheduler](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/schedule/ShPostScheduler.java) (`@Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "${shio.schedule.sweep-interval-millis:60000}")`, guarded by `shio.schedule.enabled`) processes each due post **through the write-service proxy — so each runs in its own transaction**: one failing post is logged and skipped, the rest still fire, and each commit triggers its own AFTER_COMMIT SH12 webhook. `@EnableScheduling` added on the [Shio](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/Shio.java) boot class (the first scheduler in the tree — SH13 deferred its token purge to this switch); tunables in [ShScheduleProperties](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/schedule/ShScheduleProperties.java) (`shio.schedule.*`, commented defaults in `application.properties`). **API:** `POST /api/v2/post-unified/{id}/schedule` (console-authenticated; `404` when neither draft nor published exists; `null` field clears that schedule). **Frontend:** a **Schedule** button on [post.edit.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/content/post.edit.page.tsx) opens [PostScheduleDialog](../shio-react/src/components/post-schedule.dialog.tsx) — two `datetime-local` inputs (publish/unpublish at) with clear buttons, posting via [ShPostUnifiedService](../shio-react/src/services/post-unified/post-unified.service.ts) `schedule(id, …)`; en/pt i18n. Test: `ShPostUnifiedAPITest` extended (`shio.schedule.enabled=false` so the test drives the sweep step deterministically) — future schedule not due; past publish fires + clears; past unpublish removes the published row; unknown id → 404. Spec: `docs/specs/SH15-scheduled-publish.md`.
- **SH14** — **Versioning UI (draft↔published diff + restore).** The console gets the diff/restore UX the `/versions` endpoint was waiting for, working with the unified model's two-row-per-state reality (one editable `DRAFT`, one immutable `PUBLISHED` snapshot — not a long history). **Backend:** [ShPostUnifiedWriteService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/migration/unified/ShPostUnifiedWriteService.java) gains `restoreDraftFromPublished(postId, modifier)` — copies the `PUBLISHED` row's `data`/title/summary/furl into the `DRAFT` row (re-creating the draft from published if none exists), stamps `modifiedDate`/`modifier`, and leaves the public (published) row untouched so **no SH12 webhook fires**; [ShPostUnifiedAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/unified/ShPostUnifiedAPI.java) exposes `POST /api/v2/post-unified/{id}/restore` (console-authenticated; `404` when there is no published version to restore from). No Liquibase change — reuses existing columns. **Frontend:** a **History** button on [post.edit.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/content/post.edit.page.tsx) opens [PostVersionsDialog](../shio-react/src/components/post-versions.dialog.tsx) — fetches `/versions` via [ShPostUnifiedService](../shio-react/src/services/post-unified/post-unified.service.ts) (new `restore(id)`), splits DRAFT/PUBLISHED with per-state metadata cards, computes a **field-level diff** off the post-type schema (`changed`/`added`/`removed`, defensive `asDataObject` coercion since the entity serialises `data` as a JSON string), renders it in a Table with an "only changes" toggle, and a two-step **Restore published version** button that reverts the draft and refreshes the editor form in place. en/pt i18n added. Test: `ShPostUnifiedAPITest` extended (restore reverts a diverged draft to the published title; unknown id → 404). Spec: `docs/specs/SH14-versioning-ui.md`.
- **SH13** — **Draft / preview mode (short-lived preview tokens + console UX).** An authenticated console user mints an *expiring*, single-site preview token for one post and is handed a ready-to-open preview URL at the site front-end — the durable counterpart to SH5's permanent preview *deployment* key, riding the same draft-preferred read path with **zero new read code**. **Model:** [ShApiToken](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/token/ShApiToken.java) gains `expiresAt` (nullable `Instant`; `null` = never, every durable token) + `ephemeral` (`boolean`) and an `isExpired(now)` helper; new Liquibase [v2026.2.2.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.2.2.yaml) (two `addColumn` changesets, `columnExists` MARK_RAN guards, DB-agnostic `TIMESTAMP`/`boolean`) wired into the master. **Enforcement:** [ShApiTokenFilter](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/security/auth/ShApiTokenFilter.java) drops a token whose `expiresAt` has passed (treated like disabled — passes through unauthenticated), so a preview link dies on its own with no revocation step. **Mint:** [ShPreviewTokenAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/token/ShPreviewTokenAPI.java) at `POST /api/v2/preview-token` (console-authenticated, **not** the CDA `Key` surface) resolves the post draft-preferred, mints a `PREVIEW`/`PREVIEW` `ShApiToken` confined to the post's site via the SH2 allow-list (`expiresAt = now + ttl`, `ephemeral=true`), builds `<site.url><path>?token=<tok>&url=<encoded furl>`, and returns [ShPreviewTokenResponse](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/token/ShPreviewTokenResponse.java) `{token, previewUrl, expiresAt, ttlSeconds}`; ttl is clamped to a configurable max, expired ephemeral rows are purged opportunistically on each mint, and the management list ([ShApiTokenAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/token/ShApiTokenAPI.java) via new `findByEphemeralFalseOrderByTitleAsc`) hides ephemeral tokens. Tunables in [ShCdaProperties.Preview](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShCdaProperties.java) (`shio.cda.preview.*`: enable, `ttl-seconds` 900, `max-ttl-seconds` 3600, front-end `path`/`token-param`/`url-param`; commented defaults in `application.properties`). **Console:** a **Preview Draft** button on [post.edit.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/content/post.edit.page.tsx) (shown when the post has a site) mints via [ShPreviewTokenService](../shio-react/src/services/preview-token/preview-token.service.ts) and opens the URL in a new tab (en/pt i18n). **Starter:** `create-shio-app`'s [/api/preview](../create-shio-app/template/app/api/preview/route.ts) now accepts `?token=` (stashes it in an httpOnly cookie + enables Draft Mode), and [lib/shio.ts](../create-shio-app/template/lib/shio.ts) `getShioClient()` reads draft-preferred through that per-request token under Draft Mode — the static-`secret` + long-lived `SHIO_PREVIEW_TOKEN` path still works for a permanent preview deployment; recipe [§4](recipes/nextjs-rendering.md) updated. 20 tests green (`ShPreviewTokenAPITest` 6 new — token shape, URL/furl encoding, ttl clamp, blank-url 400, disabled 404, published-furl fallback, purge; `ShApiTokenFilterTest` +2 = 14: expired-ignored, fresh-ephemeral-authenticates). Spec: `docs/specs/SH13-draft-preview-mode.md`.
- **SH12** — **Outbound webhooks on publish/unpublish/delete.** Per-site webhook subscriptions + a signed emitter on the unified write path — the backbone for SH9's incremental static regeneration and any downstream integration. **Model:** [ShSiteWebhook](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/webhook/ShSiteWebhook.java) (`@Entity site_webhook`, mirroring `ShApiToken`: `@TenantId`, target `url`, shared HMAC `secret`, optional `siteId` scope, and an `events` [`@ElementCollection` of [ShWebhookEventType](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/webhook/ShWebhookEventType.java) `PUBLISH`/`UNPUBLISH`/`DELETE`; empty = all], plus `enabled`/`owner`/`createdDate`) with a `matches(siteId, type)` predicate; new Liquibase [v2026.2.1.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.2.1.yaml) (createTable `site_webhook` + `site_webhook_event`, `not tableExists` MARK_RAN guards, DB-agnostic types) wired into the master. **Emit:** [ShPostUnifiedWriteService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/migration/unified/ShPostUnifiedWriteService.java) (the single chokepoint both `ShPostUnifiedAPI` and the SH10 CDA write surface route through) now publishes a [ShPostLifecycleEvent](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/webhook/ShPostLifecycleEvent.java) after `publish`/`unpublish`/`delete` — for unpublish/delete the site + furl are **snapshotted before the row is removed**; furl is leading-slash normalised. **Dispatch:** [ShWebhookDispatcher](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/webhook/ShWebhookDispatcher.java) listens via `@TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT)` (a rolled-back publish emits nothing), filters enabled matching subscriptions, builds the SH9 JSON body once (`{event, siteId, postId, url?, occurredAt?}`), and POSTs it off the request thread on a daemon executor with best-effort linear-backoff retry (`shio.webhook.max-attempts`). Signing is HMAC-SHA256 over the **exact body bytes** via [ShWebhookSigner](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/webhook/ShWebhookSigner.java) → `x-shio-signature: sha256=<hex>`, matching `create-shio-app`'s `/api/revalidate` receiver byte-for-byte (locked by a test against the `openssl dgst` reference digest). Blank-secret targets are skipped (HMAC needs a key). Tunables in [ShWebhookProperties](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/webhook/ShWebhookProperties.java) (`shio.webhook.*`, all commented defaults in `application.properties`). **CRUD:** [ShSiteWebhookAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/webhook/ShSiteWebhookAPI.java) at `/api/v2/site-webhook` (console-only, `anyRequest authenticated`, repo-direct like `ShApiTokenAPI`) — create auto-generates a secret when omitted; update never clobbers the secret to blank. 5 `ShWebhookSignerTest` green (contract digest + prefix + uniqueness + lowercase-64 + blank-secret-throws). **SH15** (scheduled publish/unpublish) reuses this emitter on a sweep; the console UI for managing subscriptions is a follow-up. Spec: `docs/specs/SH12-outbound-webhooks.md`.

## Block F — Market positioning / bold bets

- **SH22** — **Multi-tenancy / SaaS (core DB isolation).** Closed the leak in the partial tenant foundation: the active content tree was **not** tenant-isolated even with `shio.multi-tenant=true`. Hibernate's native `@TenantId` (DISCRIMINATOR) was already on 6 entities but missing from the tree that serves a site. Extended it to: [ShObject](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/object/ShObject.java) — the **JOINED-inheritance root**, so one `@TenantId` on the root table filters polymorphic *and* concrete subclass (`ShSite`/`ShFolder`/`ShPostType`) queries, which therefore need no column of their own; [ShPostUnified](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/post/unified/ShPostUnified.java) — the unified DRAFT/PUBLISHED store, the **critical gap** (`tenantId` is *not* added to the composite `@IdClass` — Hibernate adds `tenant_id=?` alongside the `(id,state)` PK); and `ShReference` (dropped by SH1100, since nothing wrote it). `sh_post_unified` was the only table missing a column → new Liquibase [v2026.2.4.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.2.4.yaml) (`addColumn tenant_id VARCHAR(255)`, **nullable** because the table is already populated and the startup backfill fills `'shio'` after Liquibase) wired into the master, and `sh_post_unified` added to [ShTenantBackfillRunner](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantBackfillRunner.java)`.TENANT_TABLES` (so the SH26 `Sh{H2,MariaDb,Postgres}SchemaIT` assert its column on all three engines for free). **Cross-DB fix the SH26 ITs caught:** Hibernate emits the `@TenantId` *filter predicate* UNQUOTED even under `globally_quoted_identifiers` (only the projection is quoted), so an exact-case `TENANT_ID` column (`QUOTE_ALL_OBJECTS`) is folded-missed on PostgreSQL — the discriminator column is therefore **lowercase `tenant_id`** on all 9 `@TenantId` entities, with the pre-existing columns renamed in the SH26 baseline + `v2026.2.1` carrying `validCheckSum: ANY` (its own precedent; unmapped legacy/draft tables keep `TENANT_ID`). The unit-test datasource gained the same load-bearing `DATABASE_TO_UPPER=false;CASE_INSENSITIVE_IDENTIFIERS=true` H2 params the dev/prod URL already uses, so the lowercase column matches the unquoted predicate there too. **Single-tenant is byte-for-byte unchanged** (`multi-tenant=false` → resolver returns `'shio'`, every row binds to `'shio'`); cleaned the dead `?:` ternary + unused `ShAppProperties` out of [ShTenantResolver](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantResolver.java). New [ShTenantIsolationIT](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantIsolationIT.java) (no Docker, like `ShH2SchemaIT`, with `multi-tenant=true`) **proves** isolation: rows written as tenant `alpha` are invisible to `beta` on the unified store (`findByState`/`findByIdAndState`) and across both polymorphic (`count from ShObject`) and concrete (`count from ShFolder`) queries — each tenant phase in its own transaction since the `CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver` resolves once per session-open. **Identity model unchanged** (OIDC `workspace_id` claim → username, via the existing `ShTenantFilter`). **Deferred follow-ups** (tracked on the ROADMAP SH22 line): tenant catalog (`ShTenant` entity + CRUD/provisioning), per-tenant `file_source` storage, tenant-keyed CDA cache, per-tenant post-type seeding, console UI. Spec: `docs/specs/SH22-multi-tenancy.md`.

- **SH38** — **file_source upload/serve subsystem (rebuilt on the unified model).** The prereq the SH25 image-transform epic (§VI.4) and the SH47/SH61 follow-ups were blocked on — deleted in the nuclear refactor (`ShStaticFileAPI`/`ShStaticFileUtils`/`ShStaticResourceConfiguration`), and the React [file.widget.tsx](../shio-react/src/components/widgets/file.widget.tsx) was already calling a `POST /v2/staticfile/upload` that 404'd. **Storage:** [ShFileStorageService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShFileStorageService.java) writes bytes to `<root>/<filePostId>/<fileName>` — keyed by the (globally-unique) post id, **not** the folder tree, so a folder rename/move never invalidates a path and SH47 can later prefix `tenantId` without touching the layout; root is [ShFileSourceProperties](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/property/ShFileSourceProperties.java)`.path` (`shio.file-source.path`, default `store/file_source`, relative→`user.dir`). A single `resolve()` normalizes + asserts `startsWith(root)` (the path-traversal guard); user names are reduced to their last segment by `sanitizeFileName`. **Upload:** [ShStaticFileService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileService.java)`.upload` creates a **published** `File` [ShPostUnified](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/post/unified/ShPostUnified.java) (`data.FILE` = original name → title auto-derives via the `isTitle` `FILE` attr) through the existing `ShPostUnifiedWriteService.create`, then stores the bytes in the same transaction (I/O failure rolls back the post). System post types are **not** seeded on a fresh install, so `resolveOrCreateFilePostType` bootstraps the `File` post type (its one `File`-widget `FILE` attr) on first upload. **Serve:** [ShStaticResourceConfiguration](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/ShStaticResourceConfiguration.java) (a purely-additive `WebMvcConfigurer`) maps `/file_source/**` → the storage root (`permitAll`), so bytes are public at `/file_source/<id>/<name>`; deliberately **not** `/store/**` (would expose the H2 DB + logs). [ShStaticFileAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileAPI.java) adds `POST /api/v2/staticfile/upload` (multipart → the created post, what the widget stores), `GET /{id}` (streams the bytes with a name-/probe-derived content type), and a legacy-parity `GET /pre-upload/{folderId}/{fileName}` existence check. **Cleanup:** [ShStaticFileCleanupListener](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileCleanupListener.java) listens for the `DELETE` `ShPostLifecycleEvent` the write service already publishes and removes the id-keyed dir (no-op for non-file posts, so it's safe on every delete). 13 tests green ([ShFileStorageServiceTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShFileStorageServiceTest.java) 8 — store/resolve/delete + traversal guard; [ShStaticFileAPITest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileAPITest.java) 5 — upload→post+bytes, serve, pre-upload, delete-removes-bytes, with a `@DynamicPropertySource` temp root) + full suite 155 green. **Follow-ups now unblocked:** SH39–43 (image transforms on `/file_source/**`), SH47 (per-tenant `file_source/{tenantId}/...`), SH61 (static-file manager console page), and the exchange binary-asset walk deferred by SH69/70/71 (`ShExchangeFile`/`files/` plumbing already exists). → ROADMAP §VI.4
- **SH39** — **Image-transform query-param interception on the delivery path.** The first slice of the SH25 image-transform epic: parse `?w=&h=&format=&crop=` on the file_source delivery path and **route** it to a transform pipeline — establishing the seam SH40 (resize/crop via imageio/Thumbnailator) plugs the real engine into. **Parsing:** [ShImageTransformSpec](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformSpec.java)`.parse` returns `Optional.empty()` when no transform param is present (the common case — a plain download is untouched) and a validated immutable spec otherwise; a malformed value (non-numeric/non-positive `w`/`h`, unsupported `format` ∈ {jpg,jpeg,png,gif,webp,avif}, unknown `crop` ∈ [ShImageCropMode](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageCropMode.java) {fit,fill,crop,scale}) throws [ShImageTransformException](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformException.java) (`@ResponseStatus(BAD_REQUEST)` → 400 from either delivery route). Hard ceilings (max dims, signed URLs) are deliberately left to SH43. **Pipeline seam:** [ShImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformPipeline.java) (`transform(Resource, contentType, spec) → Optional<`[ShImageTransformResult](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResult.java)`>`, empty = "not transformed, serve original"); SH39 ships only [ShNoOpImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShNoOpImageTransformPipeline.java) (always empty — SH40 supplies the real bean, marked `@Primary`). **Both delivery routes intercept:** the [ShStaticFileAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileAPI.java)`.serve` controller (`GET /api/v2/staticfile/{id}`) parses the params inline; the public `/file_source/**` resource handler gets a [ShImageTransformResourceTransformer](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResourceTransformer.java) on its chain in [ShStaticResourceConfiguration](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/ShStaticResourceConfiguration.java) (chain created `cacheResources=false` on purpose — the built-in resource cache keys on path only, ignoring the query string, so it'd cross-serve transforms; proper per-params caching is SH42). With the no-op both routes pass the original bytes through. 14 tests green ([ShImageTransformSpecTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformSpecTest.java) 8 — parse/validate; [ShImageTransformResourceTransformerTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResourceTransformerTest.java) 4 — passthrough/transform/400 with stub pipelines; +2 on `ShStaticFileAPITest` — controller passthrough + 400) + full suite 169 green. **Unblocks** SH40 (transform pipeline). → ROADMAP §VI.4
- **SH40** — **Resize/crop transform pipeline (Thumbnailator/ImageIO).** Plugs the real engine into the SH39 seam: [ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline.java) is the `@Primary` [ShImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformPipeline.java), so the `/api/v2/staticfile/{id}` controller and the `/file_source/**` resource transformer now actually transform images (the SH39 `ShNoOpImageTransformPipeline` stays as the non-primary fallback). Each [ShImageCropMode](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageCropMode.java) maps to a Thumbnailator recipe: **FIT** (default) `size(w,h)` fits within preserving aspect (a single dimension scales by that axis); **FILL** `size(w,h).crop(CENTER)` covers then centre-crops to exactly `w×h`; **CROP** `sourceRegion(CENTER,w,h).scale(1.0)` centre-crops a region with no scaling; **SCALE** `size(w,h).keepAspectRatio(false)` stretches to exactly `w×h`. **Scope = resize/crop only:** the output is always re-encoded in the **source** format (jpeg/png/gif/bmp resolved from content-type then extension) — honouring `?format=` (webp/avif negotiation) is SH41, so a format-only request (no `w`/`h`) returns empty (→ original). Re-encoding in the source format also sidesteps the alpha-to-JPEG corruption a premature conversion would cause. **Graceful degradation:** a non-raster/unreadable source, an unsupported source type, or an I/O failure all fall back to `Optional.empty()` (serve the original) rather than 500 — resource ceilings (max dims, decode bombs) are SH43. 9 [ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipelineTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipelineTest.java) green (each crop mode's output dimensions, width-only, source-format preservation, format-only no-op, non-image + unsupported-type passthrough) + full suite 178 green. **Unblocks** SH41 (format conversion) / SH42 (result cache). → ROADMAP §VI.4
- **SH41** — **Output-format conversion (webp/avif/jpeg negotiation).** Lifts the SH40 pipeline from resize/crop-only to honouring `?format=`: [ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline.java) now picks the **target** ImageIO writer-format from the parsed format (falling back to the source format when none is given), re-encodes into it, and reports the matching content type on the [ShImageTransformResult](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResult.java). Three behavioural changes vs SH40: (1) a **format-only** request (no `w`/`h`) is no longer a no-op — it transcodes at the original size; (2) the served **content type changes** with the format (the `/api/v2/staticfile/{id}` controller already set it from the result; the public `/file_source/**` path derives `Content-Type` from the file name, so [ShImageTransformResourceTransformer](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResourceTransformer.java) now wraps the bytes in an `HttpResource` that pins the result's content type as a response header — overriding the `.jpg`-name guess for a jpeg→webp conversion); (3) converting an image **with alpha** to a format that can't carry it (jpeg/bmp) flattens onto a white background first, otherwise the alpha channel garbles the colours. **webp output works** via the new `org.sejda.imageio:webp-imageio` SPI (bundles native libwebp for win/mac/linux, registered through `META-INF/services`); jpeg/png/gif/bmp ride the existing ImageIO/jai-imageio writers. **avif** has no mature Java writer, so `?format=avif` (still accepted by the SH39 allow-list) falls through the same graceful path as any writer-less target → original bytes in the source format, never a 500. Resource ceilings (max dims, decode bombs) and allowed-format policy stay SH43. 19 tests green (14 [ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipelineTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipelineTest.java) — adds format-only transcode, png→jpeg + png→webp content-type changes, alpha-flatten-to-jpeg, avif graceful degrade, no-param no-op; 5 [ShImageTransformResourceTransformerTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResourceTransformerTest.java) — adds the `HttpResource` Content-Type override) + full suite 184 green. **Unblocks** SH42 (result cache) / SH43 (limits & security). → ROADMAP §VI.4
- **SH42** — **Image-transform result cache (disk/memory, ETag, tenant-aware).** A transform (decode → resize/crop → re-encode, SH40/SH41) is pure but expensive, and a given `source + ?w=&h=&format=&crop=` always yields the same bytes — so memoise them. **Caching decorator:** new [ShCachingImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShCachingImageTransformPipeline.java) is now the `@Primary` [ShImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformPipeline.java) (the SH40 [ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline.java) drops `@Primary` and becomes the injected delegate), so **both** delivery routes — the `/api/v2/staticfile/{id}` controller and the `/file_source/**` resource transformer, which already inject the primary bean — go through the cache transparently. **Store:** [ShImageTransformCache](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformCache.java) is a size-bounded in-memory LRU (`Collections.synchronizedMap` over an access-ordered `LinkedHashMap` with `removeEldestEntry`) in front of a disk cache rooted at [ShImageCacheProperties](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/property/ShImageCacheProperties.java)`.path` (`shio.image-cache.path`, default `store/image_cache`; `.enabled`, `.max-memory-entries`). The **key** is a hex SHA-256 over `tenant | filename | lastModified | length | w | h | format | crop` — the source identity is the HTTP weak-validator triple (name + mtime + size), so a re-upload that changes the bytes lands on a fresh key (old entries orphan; disk pruning is left to ops, not done here). Each entry is two files: `<hash>` (bytes) + `<hash>.ct` (content type); disk I/O is best-effort — a read/write failure degrades to a miss / no-store and is logged, never thrown, so a broken cache can't break delivery. **Tenant-aware (SH22):** the current [ShTenantContext](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantContext.java) tenant (default `shio`) is the first key component **and** the disk sub-directory (`<root>/<tenant>/<hash>`), so tenant A and B never share a cached entry or an ETag even for an identical source path + params. **ETag / 304:** the key doubles as a stable strong ETag stamped onto the [ShImageTransformResult](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResult.java) (new third record component + back-compat two-arg ctor + `withEtag`); the controller emits `ETag` and answers `If-None-Match` with `304 Not Modified`, and the public `/file_source/**` path does the same via a `setEtagGenerator` on the resource handler ([ShStaticResourceConfiguration](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/ShStaticResourceConfiguration.java)) reading the ETag off the SH41 [ShImageTransformResourceTransformer](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResourceTransformer.java)`.ShTransformedImageResource`. **Empty (serve-original) results are never cached** — a decline (non-image, writer-less target, I/O failure) must stay re-evaluable so a later transformable upload at the same id isn't poisoned by a negative entry; a disabled cache is a thin pass-through that stamps no ETag. 12 new tests (8 [ShImageTransformCacheTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformCacheTest.java) — key stability/variance/tenant-scoping, memory+disk round-trip, cross-instance disk read, tenant-prefixed layout; 3 [ShCachingImageTransformPipelineTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShCachingImageTransformPipelineTest.java) — caches-positive-stamps-etag, never-caches-empty, disabled-passthrough; +1 [ShStaticFileAPITest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileAPITest.java) `stage06` real png→webp transform → ETag header → 304 on If-None-Match) + full suite **196 green**. **Unblocks** SH43 (limits & security). → ROADMAP §VI.4
- **SH43** — **Image-transform limits & security (max dims, allowed formats, signed URLs) — completes the SH25 epic.** The transform surface (SH39–42) was an open door: any caller could request arbitrary `?w=&h=&format=` combinations, pinning CPU and flooding the SH42 cache, and a tiny but enormously-dimensioned upload could OOM the decoder. SH43 gates all of it. **Policy config:** new [ShImageTransformProperties](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/property/ShImageTransformProperties.java) (`shio.image-transform.*`) — `max-width`/`max-height` (default 5000), `max-source-pixels` (default 40 MP), `allowed-formats` (default the full SH39 set), and `signing.enabled`/`signing.secret`. **Guard:** [ShImageTransformGuard](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformGuard.java) — shared by **both** delivery routes (the [ShStaticFileAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileAPI.java)`.serve` controller injects it; the `/file_source/**` [ShImageTransformResourceTransformer](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResourceTransformer.java) is constructed with it in [ShStaticResourceConfiguration](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/ShStaticResourceConfiguration.java)) — runs three fail-fast gates after the SH39 syntactic parse: **signature** (when signing on, an unsigned/invalid request is a [ShImageTransformForbiddenException](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformForbiddenException.java) → 403, checked first so an unauthorised caller learns nothing about the policy), **allowed-format** (a parseable-but-not-permitted `format` → [ShImageTransformException](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformException.java) 400), and **max output dimensions** (→ 400). **Signed URLs:** [ShImageTransformSigner](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformSigner.java) HMAC-SHA256s a canonical `resourceId | w | h | format | crop` (URL-safe base64, constant-time `MessageDigest.isEqual` verify, fail-closed on a blank secret); the signature is bound to the `File` post id — identical on both routes (the public path takes the first segment after `/file_source/`) — so one token verifies anywhere. Console/SDK mint via `GET /api/v2/staticfile/{id}/signed-url?w=…` (returns `{sig, query}`; 409 if no secret configured). Plain (untransformed) downloads are never gated — only the transform surface. **Decode-bomb guard:** [ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipeline.java) now decodes via an `ImageReader`, reading `getWidth(0)×getHeight(0)` off the header and declining (→ original bytes, never 500) when the **source** area exceeds `max-source-pixels` — before allocating the raster. 23 new/updated tests (7 [ShImageTransformSignerTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformSignerTest.java) — round-trip, resource/param binding, fail-closed; 9 [ShImageTransformGuardTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformGuardTest.java) — each gate + signature-before-limits ordering; +2 [ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipelineTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShThumbnailatorImageTransformPipelineTest.java) over/under the pixel ceiling; +3 [ShImageTransformResourceTransformerTest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/transform/ShImageTransformResourceTransformerTest.java) over-max-width, unsigned-403, valid-sig-passes; +2 [ShStaticFileAPITest](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/api/staticfile/ShStaticFileAPITest.java) `stage07` over-max → 400, `stage08` signed-url-without-secret → 409) + full suite **219 green**. **Completes the SH25 image/asset transformation epic.** → ROADMAP §VI.4
- **SH22 follow-ups** — **Tenant catalog, provisioning, delivery-path tenant resolution, cache keying + console UI.** Built the SaaS layer on top of SH22's core DB isolation, shipped in independently-verified parts. **(A) Tenant catalog:** new [ShTenant](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/model/tenant/ShTenant.java) entity (`sh_tenant`, **not** `@TenantId`-scoped — it is the global catalog) + [ShTenantRepository](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/persistence/repository/tenant/ShTenantRepository.java) + admin CRUD on [ShTenantAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/tenant/ShTenantAPI.java) (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v2/tenant`, keeping `GET /current`); writes are `ROLE_ADMIN`-gated in [ShSecurityConfig](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/security/ShSecurityConfig.java); the reserved `shio` default tenant can't be renamed/disabled/deleted and is seeded every boot by [ShTenantOnStartup](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/onstartup/ShTenantOnStartup.java); Liquibase [v2026.2.5.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.2.5.yaml). **(D) Delivery-path tenant resolution:** [ShApiTokenFilter](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/security/auth/ShApiTokenFilter.java) now looks the token up **tenant-agnostically** (new native `findByTokenAcrossTenants` — the normal finder is itself `@TenantId`-filtered, a chicken-and-egg) and propagates the token's tenant via a request attribute that [ShTenantFilter](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantFilter.java) prefers over the principal — so CDA/GraphQL delivery is scoped to the **content owner's** tenant, not the token owner's username (proven by [ShTenantCdaDeliveryIT](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantCdaDeliveryIT.java)). This surfaced a **real Liquibase drift** the SH26 ITs missed (they never insert/select a token): SH2's `scope` + `api_token_site` and SH5's `environment` were added via `ddl-auto=update` with no changeset, so a clean Liquibase DB couldn't authenticate any token — fixed by [v2026.2.6.yaml](../shio-app/src/main/resources/db/changelog/v2026.2.6.yaml). **(C) Per-tenant provisioning:** [ShTenantProvisioningService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantProvisioningService.java) copies the default tenant's post-type model into a new tenant (reads under `shio`, writes under the new tenant in separate transactions — the resolver binds tenant per session-open), via a new `ShPostTypeAdminService.provisionFromDef` that reuses the SH16 attr-build/widget-resolution engine but preserves the `system` flag (which `upsert` guards); auto-run on tenant `create` + idempotent `POST /api/v2/tenant/{id}/provision` ([ShTenantProvisioningIT](../shio-app/src/test/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantProvisioningIT.java)). **(F) Tenant-keyed cache:** [ShCdaCacheControlFilter](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/cda/ShCdaCacheControlFilter.java) emits `Vary: Key` so a shared proxy/CDN keys CDA responses by token (→ tenant/site/env), never serving tenant A's body to B; Hazelcast stays unused (no `@Cacheable`). **(B) Console UI:** a **Tenants** admin page ([tenant.list.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/admin/tenant/tenant.list.page.tsx) + [tenant.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/admin/tenant/tenant.page.tsx)) mirroring the API-token pages — list/create/edit/delete + a Provision action — wired into routes/sidebar with en/pt i18n ([tenantAdmin.json](../shio-react/src/i18n/locales/en/tenantAdmin.json)); the [tenant service](../shio-react/src/services/tenant/tenant.service.ts) gains the CRUD + `provision`. **(E) Not applicable:** per-tenant `file_source` storage — the file-upload/serve subsystem isn't implemented in the current backend (no resource handler / upload controller / storage service; only a legacy security matcher), so there is nothing to isolate; when that feature is (re)built it must resolve `file_source/{tenantId}/...` from `ShTenantContext`. Each part green on `./mvnw -pl shio-app verify` (112 unit + 14 IT incl. cross-DB H2/MariaDB/PostgreSQL) + the console `tsc -b`/vite build. Spec: `docs/specs/SH22-multi-tenancy.md`.
- 🗑 **SH44** — as designed this is a console-only privileged tenant switch, which the "No feature whose only interface is the console" non-goal forbids, and the principal-derived ShTenantContext resolution already covers the real need.
- **SH47** — Already delivered: ShFileStorageService roots every lookup at the ShTenantContext tenant with a legacy fallback, and ShStaticFileTenantIsolationIT proves two tenants keep distinct bytes for one file id.
- **SH46** — The sidebar's Tenants item is now behind discovery.multiTenant, the same flag the header gates the switcher on, so a single-tenant install stops offering a page for tenants it does not have.
- **SH746** — sh_tenant.storage_bytes is maintained by ShTenantStorageMeter and reconciled from the tenant's own directory, so the quota kernel reads bytes in O(1) instead of walking a file tree per upload.
- **SH45** — API calls are metered as a flow: sh_tenant_api_call holds one bucket per (tenant, UTC day, surface), moved only by addition, so many nodes and many flushes agree where ShCdaRateLimiter's in-heap buckets could not. ShTenantApiCallFilter classifies cda/agent/console from inside the security chain — outside it ShTenantFilter has already cleared the tenant and the meter would read zero — and does not bill 401/403/429, which cost no credential to produce. Billing export is a ShBillingExporter SPI handed a closed day (opt-in, at-least-once, idempotent on tenant+period), with GET /api/v2/tenant/usage as the pull side (design §VI.5 superseded: it called the meter blocked on Viglet's quota SPI, when only ENFORCING a ceiling needs that SPI — counting never did, so the meter shipped Shio-local while SH110's ceiling stays blocked).

## Block E — Console migration (in flight)

- **SH-19a** — React console (`shio-react`, Vite + shadcn/ui + TS) stood up following Turing-React patterns: content navigation, post/post-type editors, 14 dynamic widgets, i18n (en/pt). Ongoing replacement of the legacy AngularJS UI (tracked as **SH19** in ROADMAP). See project memory `project_shio_react_migration.md`.

- **SH56** — **Auth Providers console page.** Migrated the legacy AngularJS `config/provider/auth` screens to `shio-react`, the first slice of SH19's `config/` section. New [auth-provider.model.ts](../shio-react/src/models/provider/auth-provider.model.ts) + [auth-provider.service.ts](../shio-react/src/services/provider/auth-provider.service.ts) (over the **already-existing** `/api/v2/provider/auth` API — list/get/create/update/delete + `vendor`/`model`), a list page (`auth-provider.list.page.tsx`, since deleted in SH910) and an edit page ([auth-provider.page.tsx](../shio-react/src/app/console/admin/auth-provider/auth-provider.page.tsx)) reusing the api-token/tenant CRUD pattern (sticky save bar, vendor `Select`, enabled `Switch`). Because each provider's settings are a free-form `properties` map (the `ShAuthProviderInstanceBean`), the edit page renders a **dynamic key/value properties editor** (add/edit/remove) rather than hardcoding vendor-specific fields. Wired into `admin.routes.tsx` + `ADMIN_AUTH_PROVIDERS` route + the Administration sidebar (Fingerprint icon), with en/pt `authProvider` i18n. Green on `tsc -b`. The remaining `config/` surface (exchange providers, email, search) has **no v2 backend** and is decomposed into SH57–SH61 on the ROADMAP. → ROADMAP §V.1

- **SH57** — **Exchange Providers console page + v2 API.** The legacy AngularJS `config/provider/exchange` screens had **no v2 backend** (the `ShExchangeProviderInstance`/`...Vendor` entities, repositories and bean already existed; only the controller + service were missing). Added [ShExchangeProviderAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/provider/exchange/ShExchangeProviderAPI.java) at `/api/v2/provider/exchange` (list/get/create/update/delete + `vendor`/`model`/`sort`) and [ShExchangeProviderService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/provider/exchange/ShExchangeProviderService.java) — byte-for-byte the SH56 auth-provider pattern, storing each instance's free-form `properties` map as `ShConfigVar` rows keyed by `shio.config.exchange` (`/provider/exchange/%s`). A default **Shio Package** vendor is seeded on first boot ([ShExchangeProviderVendorOnStartup](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/onstartup/provider/exchange/ShExchangeProviderVendorOnStartup.java) + `ShExchangeSystemProviderVendor.PACKAGE`, wired into `ShOnStartup`) so the vendor select isn't empty. Frontend mirrors SH56: [exchange-provider.model.ts](../shio-react/src/models/provider/exchange-provider.model.ts) + [exchange-provider.service.ts](../shio-react/src/services/provider/exchange-provider.service.ts), a list page (`exchange-provider.list.page.tsx`, since deleted in SH910) + an [edit page](../shio-react/src/app/console/admin/exchange-provider/exchange-provider.page.tsx) with the dynamic key/value properties editor, wired into `admin.routes.tsx` + `ADMIN_EXCHANGE_PROVIDERS` + the Administration sidebar (ArrowsExchange icon), with en/pt `exchangeProvider` i18n. Green on backend `compile` + `tsc -b`. Providers gain real utility once the SH67 exchange engine consumes them as remote import/export sources. → ROADMAP §V.1

- **SH60** — **Legacy commerce/recaptcha widgets — deprecated (not ported).** Port-or-deprecate decision for the AngularJS `payment` (payment-slip/boleto, rede-card, Cielo shopline) and `recaptcha` widgets: **deprecate both**, don't port to React. Rationale — payment processing and form-spam protection belong to the consuming front-end app in a headless-first product (§0.4 / Block B is primary); both are bound to server-rendered Thymeleaf forms (themselves slated for SH20 deprecation); and neither survived the nuclear refactor with a backend, so "porting" would mean building a documented non-goal from scratch. The `payment` widgets live **entirely** under `resources/ui/` (`templates/widget/payment/*` + `js/src/feature/ecommerce/*`) so they retire with the AngularJS tree (SH21). The `reCAPTCHA` widget had an **orphaned backend seed** in [ShWidgetOnStartup](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/onstartup/widget/ShWidgetOnStartup.java) pointing at `com.viglet.shio.widget.ShReCaptchaWidget` (a class deleted in the refactor) — that seed + the `ShSystemWidget.RECAPTCHA` constant are removed now (not covered by SH21, which only sweeps `resources/ui/`). No React widget existed for either; a `reCAPTCHA`-typed attr already rendered as the Text fallback via `getWidget()`. → ROADMAP §V.1

- **SH21** — **Legacy AngularJS tree (`resources/ui/`) deleted.** The terminal Block E step: removed the entire `shio-app/src/main/resources/ui/` directory (**330 tracked files** — the minified AngularJS console `shio.min.js` + ~105 AngularJS templates, the `welcome.js`/legacy login + welcome pages, legacy css/js/img/fonts/svg/media assets, the old GraphiQL `vendor/`, the PWA icon/manifest assets, and the 21 now-orphaned Thymeleaf form/auth templates left by SH20). The React console (`shio-react`, built into `resources/public/`) and the headless CDA are the only surfaces now. **Wiring removed/fixed:** dropped `classpath:/ui/public/` from `spring.web.resources.static-locations` (now just `classpath:/public/`) and repointed the resource-chain content-versioning paths from the dead `/js,/css,/img` to `/assets/**` ([application.properties](../shio-app/src/main/resources/application.properties)); pruned the now-dead `permitAll` matchers in [ShSecurityConfig](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/spring/security/ShSecurityConfig.java) that only served `ui/public/` (`/welcome/**`, `/fonts/**`, `/media/**`, `/css/**`, `/js/**`, `/img/**`, `/template/**`, `/vendor/**`, `/svg/**`), keeping every matcher the React SPA + CDA actually use (`/`, `/index.html`, `/assets/**`, `/favicon.ico`, `/*.png`, `/manifest.json`, `/console/**`, `/login/**`, `/setup`, `/content/**`, `/preview/**`, `/thirdparty/**` webjars, `/store/**`, `/file_source/**`, `/graphiql/**`, `/universal-editor/**`). Verified no residual `ui/public`/`ui/templates`/`classpath:/ui` references remain in Java/resources/pom. **Also dropped all 27 `org.webjars*` dependencies** (jQuery, Bootstrap, the whole `angular*` family, TinyMCE, ace-builds, font-awesome, moment, ng-file-upload, …) from [pom.xml](../shio-app/pom.xml) — they only fed the deleted AngularJS console; the React app uses its own npm deps — and removed the now-dead `/thirdparty/**` permitAll matcher that served them. Full backend suite green; app boots and serves the React console from `/public/`. **This completes Block E (Legacy retirement).** → ROADMAP §V.3

- **SH20** — **Thymeleaf site rendering removed.** Investigation finding: there is **no** server-side Thymeleaf site/page rendering left — the nuclear refactor deleted the legacy split-model page renderer, the only `@Controller` ([ShIndexContext](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/ShIndexContext.java)) just `forward:`s to the React SPA (`/index.html`), there are zero `ModelAndView`/view-name returns, and nothing reads `ShWidget` template paths server-side (`getTemplate` has no callers). ## Block G — Content portability (exchange)

- **SH68** — **Exchange package format (unified model).** Rebuilt the foundation of the exchange subsystem (deleted with `com.viglet.shio.exchange` in the nuclear refactor `2d3eb353`), now on the unified post model. New DTO records in [com.viglet.shio.exchange.model](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/model): [ShExchangePackage](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/model/ShExchangePackage.java) (root `export.json` model — `version`/`exportedAt`/`generator` + site/post-type/folder/post/file lists; defaults version + null-safe lists in the compact constructor) plus `ShExchangeSite`/`ShExchangeFolder` (carries `rootFolder`+`siteId`+`parentFolderId` to rebuild the tree)/`ShExchangePost` (post content carried **verbatim** as a `tools.jackson` `JsonNode`, `state`/`postTypeName` as decoupled strings)/`ShExchangeFile`; post-types reuse the canonical SH16 [ShPostTypeDef](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/post/type/dto/ShPostTypeDef.java) so the content model keeps one interchange shape. [ShExchangePackageCodec](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/ShExchangePackageCodec.java) is the format plumbing only (no entity mapping / id-remapping): pretty-printed manifest read/write, the `export.json` + `files/` directory layout, and zip/unzip with single-wrapping-dir unwrapping (GitHub-style zips) + a zip-slip guard; failures wrap into [ShExchangeException](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/ShExchangeException.java). 5 pure `ShExchangePackageCodecTest` green (manifest + zip round-trip, wrapped-dir, zip-slip, version/null normalization). → ROADMAP §VII.1
- **SH69** — **Site export → zip.** The read-only half: [ShSiteExportService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/site/ShSiteExportService.java) walks a site → root folders → child folders (recursive) → unified posts (**both** DRAFT and PUBLISHED rows) → the post-types they reference (emitted once as the SH16 `ShPostTypeDef` via `ShPostTypeAdminMapper`), parses each post's `data` CLOB back to a verbatim `JsonNode`, and packs an [ShExchangeArchive](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/site/ShExchangeArchive.java) (`fileName`+bytes) through the SH68 codec via a temp dir. Wired at `GET /api/v2/site/{id}/export` ([ShSiteAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/site/ShSiteAPI.java)`.export`, streams `application/zip` + `Content-Disposition`; 404 unknown) — the console **Download** action that was 404ing. Static binary assets deferred until the file_source subsystem exists (SH38) — `files` is empty, no `files/` dir. 4 `ShSiteExportServiceTest` green (round-trip-through-the-zip via the codec + endpoint + 404). → ROADMAP §VII.2
- **SH72** — **Tenant provisioning rebased onto the exchange engine.** [ShTenantProvisioningService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/tenant/ShTenantProvisioningService.java) no longer hand-copies post-types — it now **exports the default `shio` tenant** ([ShSiteExportService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/site/ShSiteExportService.java)`.buildTenantPackage` — all sites walked + all post-types) and **clones the package into the new tenant** via [ShSiteImportService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/site/ShSiteImportService.java)`.provisionInto` (the SH70 clone path, refactored to return a `CloneResult` with the post-type count). So "new site" (SH71), "site import" (SH70) and "new tenant" (SH72) share **one** provisioning engine that can't drift. A new tenant now gets the default tenant's full content (sites + folders + posts + post-types), not just the model. Reads-source/writes-copy still run in separate transactions under different `ShTenantContext` values (the per-session-open resolver). **Idempotent:** content is cloned only into an empty tenant (`shSiteRepository.count() == 0`; an already-seeded tenant only tops up post-types), so a re-provision never duplicates sites. **Global-unique-name workaround:** `ShSite.name` carries a global unique index and `tenant_id` lives on the JOINED `ShObject` root (not on `ShSite`), so a tenant-scoped composite isn't possible without denormalising — provisioned site names are therefore tenant-suffixed (`"Blog (acme)"`) to clear the index; a truly tenant-scoped site name is a follow-up. `ShTenantProvisioningIT` extended (2 tests): the original post-type copy/isolation/idempotency + a new full-content clone (sites + Welcome/About pages into `gamma`, re-provision doesn't duplicate). → ROADMAP §VII.5
- **SH71** — **Default bootstrap-site template on site creation.** Closes the regression where the rebuilt `ShSiteWriteService.create()` left a new site blank (only `ShSite` + an empty root folder) — pre-refactor, creating a site cloned a full starter. New [ShBootstrapSiteProvider](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/site/ShBootstrapSiteProvider.java) reads a versioned, in-repo exchange package at [classpath:/import/bootstrap-site/export.json](../shio-app/src/main/resources/import/bootstrap-site/export.json) (SH68 format — a `Page` post-type + Home/Pages folders + Welcome/About sample pages), rewrites the template site's metadata with the user's input (name/description/url/furl/owner) so the clone carries the user's identity but the template's content tree, and clones via a new `ShSiteImportService.importPackage(ShExchangePackage, owner)` overload (SH70 path, no unzip). Wired into [ShSiteWriteService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/site/ShSiteWriteService.java)`.create()` — **best-effort**: a missing/unreadable template or any clone failure returns `null` and falls back to the previous plain site + empty root folder, so site creation is never blocked. Replaces the legacy GitHub-zip download path (`openviglet/bootstrap-site`) with an in-repo artifact. 1 `ShSiteBootstrapTest` green (create → asserts user's name kept, `Page` provisioned, Home+Pages folders, Welcome+About pages). → ROADMAP §VII.4
- **SH70** — **Site import / clone.** The write half: [ShSiteImportService](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/exchange/site/ShSiteImportService.java) unzips a package and **clones** it — provisions each post-type via `ShPostTypeAdminService.provisionFromDef` (idempotent, reuses the live model), pre-generates a fresh UUID for every site/folder/post id (a post's DRAFT+PUBLISHED rows share one → no PK collision even re-importing into the same install), persists sites (name/furl de-duplicated against existing rows), folders **parent-first** (FK-safe via recursion), then posts — rewriting embedded `data` id references through the remap (a widget-agnostic string swap over the unique UUID tokens, covering Content Select / File targets). All in one transaction (atomic import). Exposed at multipart `POST /api/v2/import` ([ShExchangeImportAPI](../shio-app/src/main/java/com/viglet/shio/api/imports/ShExchangeImportAPI.java), returns the new site; 400 on malformed package). Frontend: new `site.import.page.tsx` — since deleted in SH910, its bento counterpart carries this — plus the `SITE_IMPORT` route registered (the content-nav **Import** button was navigating to a dead route); `ShSiteService.import` now returns the created site to navigate to it. Binary assets deferred with the export side (SH38). 3 `ShSiteImportServiceTest` green (export→import round-trip with fresh ids, data reference remap, multipart endpoint 201/400). → ROADMAP §VII.3
